display_name: Maharaja Bir Bikram & Regent Kanchan Prava Devi
one_line: The modernising Maharaja of Tripura and his resolute queen-regent at the brink of Tripura’s merger with India.

appearance.age_look: Bir Bikram appears in his early 30s with a tall, athletic build; Kanchan Prava Devi appears in her late 20s to early 30s with a dignified, graceful frame.
appearance.face: Bir Bikram has an oval face, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache, and sharp, earnest anime eyes with a calm yet determined default expression; Kanchan Prava Devi has a heart-shaped face, light-brown complexion, soft but steady anime eyes, fine brows, and a serene, thoughtful default expression that hints at quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Bir Bikram’s hair is jet-black, short and neatly combed back under a cream-coloured Tripuri-style turban with a slim maroon band and a single white plume; Kanchan Prava Devi’s hair is long, jet-black and center-parted, tied into a low bun at the nape, with a thin gold maang-tikka along the parting and a light cream pallu drawn modestly over the back of her head.
appearance.costume: Bir Bikram wears a tailored cream-coloured royal achkan (knee-length coat) of fine cotton-silk with subtle vertical weaving, a high collar and maroon piping along the placket and cuffs, over a soft maroon angavastram-style stole draped from his left shoulder across his chest; he pairs this with straight cream churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, polished brown leather jutti shoes, and a broad maroon silk cummerbund around his waist, while a simple gold wristwatch and a narrow sash of a modern Tripura-inspired pattern (cream base with maroon and green geometric borders) hint at his reformist modernity; Kanchan Prava Devi wears an elegant Tripuri-influenced sari ensemble: a cream base sari with a wide maroon border and fine green stripe, pleated neatly and wrapped in a modest Nivi drape that fully covers her torso, paired with a maroon three-quarter-sleeved blouse, and a thin woven Risa-like stole in maroon and cream folded over her left shoulder, with delicate gold bangles, small gold jhumka earrings, a simple nose pin, and a modest pearl necklace conveying regal understatement.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment-style scroll with a visible red wax seal and ribbon, representing treaties like the Tripura Merger Agreement, held primarily by Kanchan Prava Devi at the center while Bir Bikram’s gloved hand lightly steadies it from the side.

ref_desc: A tall, athletic Bir Bikram with an oval face, short black hair under a cream turban, cream achkan with maroon accents and churidar, beside graceful Kanchan Prava Devi in a cream-and-maroon Tripuri sari, both holding a red-sealed parchment scroll, all in cream, maroon, green and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a royal couple from late princely Tripura: a tall, athletic young Maharaja Bir Bikram with an oval medium-brown face, neat moustache, sharp earnest eyes, and short jet-black hair slicked back under a cream Tripuri turban with a slim maroon band and single white plume, wearing a cream cotton-silk achkan with subtle vertical texture, high collar, and maroon piping on placket and cuffs, a maroon stole draped from his left shoulder across his chest, a broad maroon silk cummerbund, slim cream churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, and polished brown leather jutti shoes, with a simple gold wristwatch and a narrow cream sash edged in maroon and green hinting at Tripuri patterns; beside him, draw Regent Kanchan Prava Devi with a heart-shaped light-brown face, soft but determined anime eyes, fine brows, and a serene, thoughtful expression, her long jet-black hair center-parted and tied into a low bun at the nape, a thin gold maang-tikka along the parting, and a light cream pallu drawn modestly over the back of her head, wearing a cream sari with a broad maroon border and fine green stripe in a modest Nivi drape that fully covers her torso, over a maroon three-quarter-sleeved blouse, a folded maroon-and-cream Tripuri-inspired Risa-like stole over her left shoulder, delicate gold bangles, small gold jhumka earrings, a simple nose pin, and a short pearl necklace; show them standing slightly angled toward each other, jointly holding a rolled parchment-style scroll with a red wax seal and ribbon as their shared signature prop, and ensure the overall palette is dominated by cream, maroon, deep green, gold and brown leather, with clean linework so this exact design can be redrawn consistently from head to toe.
